text:
rachel: FYI new hire hit a weird combo of issues in quickstart: installer told them to run `redwoodctl init` but sample app expects profile `quickstart-app` so nothing wired up.

omar: ouch. installer should suggest the exact command. what did the login do?

rachel: they ran `redwoodctl login --headless` and it opened the browser but CLI printed `waiting for callback` forever. Browser showed the redirect to callback URL but CLI never accepted it.

lina: Are they on a VPN or using Docker? bind issues or TLS intercept are usual suspects.
achel: On macOS, VPN + enterprise TLS inspection. Also `SSL_CERT_FILE` is set in their environment to point at the corporate CA, but redwoodctl ignored it and failed with `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority`.

omar: We intentionally don't read `SSL_CERT_FILE` in the runtime right now. We should at least detect it and warn during init/doctors.

lina: Agreed. Quick fixes: 1) update postinstall text to recommend `redwoodctl init --profile quickstart-app` and show `redwoodctl login --headless --open-in-browser` as a fallback, 2) doctor should detect `SSL_CERT_FILE`/`REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE` and print a clear hint, 3) make headless login detect repeated TLS x509 errors and surface the "corp cert" guidance instead of noisy retries.

rachel: Also request: reduce retry spam. Right now it retries every 500ms for 30s. Let's make it exponential (1s, 4s, 12s) and print a single suggestion line after 10s.

omar: Another edge: sample app's quickstart uses `quickstart-app` profile name which diverges from earlier `quickstart` used in our docs. We should normalize names and add a migration note in `redwoodctl init` if an existing profile exists.

lina: For headless in containerized devs, we should document `--local-callback-host=0.0.0.0` and add a `--trust-local-ca /tmp/dev-ca.pem` flag scoped to the login call only (not persisted). Make sure CLI warns prominently that it won't add the CA to the system store.

ci-bot: deploy-check: docs branch `devex/init-profile-fixes` lint OK

rachel: I'll open a small PR that changes the postinstall message and doctor output, and a separate PR to adjust retry/backoff. Tagging devex and eng-platform.

omar: thanks. please include a tiny test that simulates `SSL_CERT_FILE` env var to ensure the doctor picks it up.

lina: And add a one-liner to the quickstart README: "If you see TLS x509 errors on login, try the device-code flow: `redwoodctl login --device-code`"

rachel: filing issues now.

ci-bot: reminder: include CHANGELOG entries for the CLI UX tweaks.
